description: The WindSentinel™ FLIDAR buoy has a floating platform that is 20.7 feet (6.3 meters) long by 10.5 feet (3.2 meters) wide and weighs 15,000 pounds (6,818 kilograms).
context_quote: The floating platform consists of the AXYS Navy Oceanographic Meteorological Automated Device hull, mooring chain, and clump weight anchor. The hull consists of marine-grade 5086 aluminum and measures 20.7 ft (6.3 meters [m]) long by 10.5 ft (3.2 m) wide and weighs 15,000 pounds (lbs) (6,818 kilograms [kg]) (bare hull weight).

description: The vertical profile of the WindSentinel™ FLIDAR buoy, including instrumentation, is approximately 13.5 feet (4.1 meters) from the sea surface to the top of the hull mast.
context_quote: The vertical profile of the WindSentinel™, including instrumentation, will be approximately 13.5 ft (4.1 m) from the sea surface to the top of the hull mast.

description: The submerged portion of the WindSentinel™ FLIDAR buoy hull measures approximately 8.5 feet (2.6 meters) below the sea surface from the water line to the bottom of the mooring yoke.
context_quote: The submerged portion of the hull would measure approximately 8.5 ft (2.6 m) below the sea surface from the water line to the bottom of the mooring yoke.

description: The TRIAXYS Buoy has a diameter of 3.6 feet (1.1 meters) and a vertical profile of approximately 1.8 feet (0.55 meters) from the sea surface to the top of the buoy.
context_quote: The TRIAXYS Buoy is a 3.6 ft (1.1 m) round buoy that measures directional waves & currents as well as water temperature (Figure 3-2). The vertical profile of the TRIAXYS Buoy will be approximately 1.8 ft (0.55 m) from the sea surface to the top of the buoy.

description: The submerged portion of the TRIAXYS Buoy hull measures approximately 1.8 feet (0.55 meters) below the sea surface from the waterline to the bottom of the buoy.
context_quote: The submerged portion of the buoy hull would measure approximately 1.8 ft (0.55 m) below the sea surface from the waterline to the bottom of the buoy.

description: The WindSentinel™ FLIDAR buoy has a mooring system consisting of a chain that connects the buoy to both a primary and secondary clump anchor.
context_quote: The WindSentinels™ will be attached to the seafloor by means of a u-mooring design which is comprised of a chain that connects the WindSentinel™ to both a primary and secondary clump anchor as well as a pendant buoy (Figure 3-4).

description: The primary clump weight for the WindSentinel™ FLIDAR buoy mooring system weighs approximately 5.5 tons (5,000 kilograms) and the secondary clump weight weighs approximately 2.5 tons (2,268 kilograms).
context_quote: The primary and secondary clump weights would weigh approximately 5.5 tons (5,000 kg) and 2.5 tons (2,268 kg), respectively and sit on the seabed for a total area of up to 42 ft [2] (3.9 m [2] ).

description: The TRIAXYS Buoy mooring system consists of 4.9 feet (1.5 meters) of chain that connects the buoy to a 265.8 foot (81 meter) mooring chain attached to a 1.1 ton (1,000 kilogram) clump weight.
context_quote: The TRIAXYS Buoy mooring design will consist of 4.9 ft (1.5 m) of open link chain which will run from the buoy to a 265.8 ft (81 m) mooring chain. The mooring chain will then be attached to a 1.1 ton (1,000 kg) clump weight that will rest on the seafloor for an area of approximately 10.2 ft [2] (1 m [2] ).

description: The WindSentinel™ FLIDAR buoy is capable of operating at full capacity on battery power alone for up to seven days in the event of failure of the key power supply systems.
context_quote: In the event of failure of the key power supply systems, the WindSentinel™ instrumentation would be capable of operating at full capacity on battery power alone for up to seven days.

description: The TRIAXYS Buoy has enough reserve battery capacity to power the buoy in a standard sampling routine for up to 3 months without being recharged.
context_quote: Due to the surplus of solar power provided by the solar array, the batteries have enough reserve capacity to power the buoy in a standard sampling routine for up to 3 months without being charged.

description: Planned maintenance for the WindSentinel™ FLIDAR buoy is scheduled at 6-month and 12-month intervals.
context_quote: Planned on-site maintenance for the WindSentinel™ Buoy is scheduled at 6 and 12 months and will be completed by a vessel comparable to the support vessel used for installation (see Section 4.2).

description: Planned maintenance for the TRIAXYS Buoy is scheduled every 3 months for the first year of operation.
context_quote: Planned on-site maintenance for the TRIAXYS Buoy is scheduled every 3 months for the first year of operation and will be completed by a vessel comparable to the support vessel used for installation (see Section 4.2).

description: The WindSentinel™ FLIDAR buoy has been designed with consideration for avian species, including minimizing landing areas and installing anti-perching devices on the lights and mast.
context_quote: The outer hull is constructed of a corrosion resistant marine grade stainless steel. The hull has also been designed with consideration for avian species. Landing areas have been minimized and anti-perching devices will be installed on the lights and mast.

description: The total area of the anchor chain sweep associated with the long-term operation of the WindSentinel™ FLIDAR buoy is anticipated to be approximately 6.9 acres (2.8 hectares) for the F1 location and 7.9 acres (3.2 hectares) for the F2 location.
